name: Kumu Art Museum
funding: Part of the state-funded Art Museum of Estonia.

name: Addis Foto Fest
funding: Produced by Desta for Africa, directed by Aida Muluneh. The last sponsor list is from 2018: Swiss Embassy, Canon, National Geographic Society, Marriott and others. None published since.

name: Zoma Museum
funding: Privately funded. Land bought from 2013 with Assegued's income as a curator and anthropologist and sales of Sime's artwork. Sime is represented by James Cohan Gallery, New York.

name: Listasavn Føroya (National Gallery of the Faroe Islands)
Fiji Museum
funding: A statutory body on a government grant (F$697,525 operating plus F$500,000 capital in 2018/19). Its digitisation has run on a US Ambassadors Fund grant since 2021.

name: Oceania Centre for Arts, Culture and Pacific Studies (USP)
funding: A small unit of the University of the South Pacific (established 1997). Its 2026 residency is co-funded with Creative New Zealand and Creative Australia.

name: EMMA Espoo Museum of Modern Art
funding: City of Espoo, plus the Saastamoinen Foundation collection.

name: Amos Rex
funding: Owned and run by the Amos Anderson Fund (formerly Konstsamfundet). Helsingin Sanomat is main partner; Genelec and Bauer Media Outdoor are partners.

name: HIAP (Helsinki International Artist Programme)
funding: Taike Arts Promotion Centre Finland, the Ministry of Education and Culture and the City of Helsinki are its main funders.

name: Kiasma Museum of Contemporary Art
funding: €11M. Finnish Ministry of Education and Culture, Finnish National Gallery.
